name: thirteen-week-cash-flow
description: Build and maintain a rolling 13-week cash flow forecast — the gold standard for short-term liquidity management used by CFOs, turnaround advisors, and lenders. Produces a week-by-week cash receipts and disbursements model, variance tracking against actuals, borrowing base calculations, covenant monitoring, and executive cash dashboards. Use when managing tight liquidity, preparing for a credit facility, navigating distress, or when the board/lender demands weekly cash visibility. NOT for: long-range (12-36 month) strategic planning (use startup-financial-model), annual budgeting, tax cash flow projections, or real-time bank balance monitoring (connect to banking API for that).
